title: Request Body with Pydantic
prompt:
Create a FastAPI endpoint that accepts a JSON request body validated with Pydantic.

**Requirements:**
1. Import `FastAPI` from `fastapi`
2. Import `BaseModel` from `pydantic`
3. Define a class `Item` that inherits from `BaseModel` with `name` and `price` fields
4. Define a function `create_item` decorated with `@app.post('/items')` that accepts an `Item` body
5. Return the received item data
hints: Import BaseModel: from pydantic import BaseModel
Define models as classes that inherit from BaseModel
Type annotations on class fields define the schema: name: str
Use the model as a function parameter type for automatic validation

main.py.name: create_item
main.py.description: Define a POST endpoint that accepts an Item body
Use type annotations on function parameters
main.py.hint: Annotate the parameter as item: Item for automatic validation
